blocks.text: Yeh kaam achhi tarah karne ke liye scientists mukhtalif qisam ke variables pehchante hain. Independent variable woh cheez hai jo experiment karne wala khud badalta hai taa ke us ka asar dekhe. Dependent variable woh hai jo naapa ya dekha jata hai; yeh independent variable ke badalne se badalta hai. Control variables (constants) baqi tamam cheezen hain jo poore experiment mein aik jaisi rakhi jati hain taa ke test munsifana (fair) ho.

Control group experiment ka woh group hai jise treatment (ilaaj) nahi milta, yani us mein independent variable nahi badla jata. Yeh muqable ki bunyad (baseline) hai: is se experimental group ke nataij mila kar dekhe jate hain, taa ke pata chale ke independent variable waqai koi asar karta hai ya nahi. Experimental group woh group hai jise test hone wala khaas treatment, halaat ya mahol ki tabdeeli di jati hai; is ka rad-e-amal (response) naap kar control group se mila kar dekha jata hai ke treatment ka biological amal ya khasiyaton par kya asar hua.

items: Pehle experiment ka sawal likhein; is se saaf ho jata hai ke aap kya jaanna chahte hain.
Apni research ki bunyad par hypothesis banayein, yani maujooda ilm ke mutabiq aap ke khayal mein kya hoga.
Variables saaf pehchanein: kya badlenge (independent variable), kya naapenge (dependent variable) aur kya aik jaisa rakhenge (control variable).
Groups banayein: control group (treatment ya independent variable mein tabdeeli nahi milti) aur experimental group (treatment ya tabdeeli milti hai).
Tareeqa (procedure) tafseel se tay karein: subjects kaise chune aur groups mein baante jayenge, har group ke saath kya kiya jayega, naap kitni der aur kitni baar hogi, aur data kaise jama hoga.
Munasib tareeqe (average nikalna, graph banana ya statistical tests) istemal kar ke groups ke nataij milayein aur dekhein ke koi wazeh (significant) asar hai ya nahi.
Asal hypothesis aur sawal ki roshni mein nateeja nikalein; nataij ki bunyad par hypothesis qubool (accept) ya radd (reject) karein.

blocks.text: Experiment: albino chuhon (mice) mein zyada charbi wali ghiza (high-fat diet) ka wazan par asar

items: Sawal: kya high-fat diet chuhon ka wazan aam (normal) ghiza se zyada barhati hai?
Hypothesis: high-fat diet wale chuhe normal diet walon se zyada wazan barhayenge.

Variables: independent variable: ghiza ki qisam. Dependent variable: wazan ka barhna. Control variables: chuhon ki umr, strain (nasl), jins (sex), pinjra, mahol (roshni, temperature) aur khilane ka waqt waghera.
Groups: control group: normal diet wale chuhe. Experimental group: high-fat diet wale chuhe.

Tareeqa: (1) umr, strain aur jins mein milte julte albino chuhe chunein. (2) unhein randomly (qura andazi se) control aur experimental groups mein baantein. (3) sab chuhon ko aik jaise halaat (pinjre, roshni, temperature, nami) mein rakhein. (4) har group ko us ki ghiza muqarrar muddat (maslan 8 hafte) tak dein. (5) har chuhe ka wazan har hafte naap kar likhein.
Nataij ka analysis: experiment ke aakhir mein statistical tests ya graphs se dono groups ke ausat wazan barhne ka muqabla karein.

Nateeja: agar high-fat group ka ausat wazan statistically wazeh (significant) taur par zyada barhe to hypothesis ki taeed hoti hai, yani ghiza ki qisam wazan par asar dalti hai. Agar groups mein wazeh farq na ho, ya normal diet wala group zyada barhe, to hypothesis radd hoti hai; matlab in halaat mein ghiza ke ilawa doosri cheezen zyada ahem hain.

blocks.prompt: Chuhon ko groups mein randomly (qura andazi se) kyun baanta jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Taa ke chuhon ke apne farq (maslan kuch qudrati taur par zyada mote hon) dono groups mein barabar bat jayen aur groups mein sirf ghiza ka farq baqi rahe. Is se test munsifana aur ghair janibdar (unbiased) rehta hai.

items: Independent variable badlein, dependent variable naapein, control variables aik jaise rakhein.
Control group baseline hai; experimental group ko treatment milta hai.
Saat qadam: sawal, hypothesis, variables, groups, procedure, analysis, nateeja.
Misaal: high-fat diet aur chuhon ka wazan, 8 hafte, randomly baante gaye groups.
